scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.lint: pnpm exec prettier --check package.json artifacts/api-server/package.json artifacts/html-port-studio/package.json artifacts/mockup-sandbox/package.json
scripts.test:static: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run validate:clerk-skill
scripts.test:unit: node --test scripts/port-authority.test.mjs scripts/free-ports.test.mjs scripts/validate-api-codegen.test.mjs scripts/check-failure-gate.test.mjs scripts/check-regression-guard.test.mjs scripts/workspace-skill.test.mjs scripts/validation-tier-registration.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @workspace/html-port-studio run test:unit
scripts.test-fast: pnpm run validate:failure-gate && pnpm run test-fast:run
scripts.test-standard: pnpm run validate:failure-gate && pnpm run test-standard:run
scripts.test-standard:run: pnpm run test:static && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:api && pnpm run test:browser
scripts.test-standard-plus: pnpm run validate:failure-gate && pnpm run test-standard-plus:run
scripts.test-standard-plus:run: pnpm run test:static && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:api && pnpm run test:codegen
scripts.test-heavy: pnpm run validate:failure-gate && pnpm run test-heavy:run
scripts.test-heavy:run: pnpm run test:static && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:api && pnpm run test:codegen && pnpm run test:browser
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
